_comment: Chronological train/validation/test assignment by DRAFT CLASS. Never random: a random split would let a model learn from later draft classes when scoring earlier ones. Preprocessing (imputation, scaling, PCA) must be fit on the train split only -- enforced by src/modeling/preprocess.py.
notes: 2005 is the first draft class whose final college season (2004) is inside CFBD coverage; 2000-2004 classes stay in outcome/EDA tables but are excluded from college-feature models.
2021 is the last class with a fully observed five-season window (2021-2025) given observation_end_season=2025.
2022-2026 classes have incomplete windows: their five-year targets are NULL (right-censored), not failures. They remain usable for survival models and for scoring.
